reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2026
reviews_list.review_title: Pay less, get more in life.

review_content.Placements: Around 250 students in my course. Students are doing internships both on campus and off campus. The last batch had 270 students, and around 120 students got jobs on campus because they met the criteria. The highest package is 15 LPA, and the minimum is 2.7 LPA. Hiring companies are like Paytm and local companies.
review_content.Infrastructure: The facilities are also good, such as visiting the library in free time and playing sports in the playground, but sometimes the food in the hostel is not good, which is complained about by hostelers. Wi-Fi is available, but sometimes it also does not work because these facilities are not provided in classes.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2027
reviews_list.review_title: A good college for admission.

review_content.Placements: Placement in our branch is decent enough, with around 70-80% getting placed, and 70% got internships as well. The average salary is around 10-12 LPA for the CS branch, and the highest went up to 90 LPA. And companies like Amazon, TCS, Zomato, Nvidia, and other good ones have paid a visit for recruitment. The potential for placement in college is good, as Nagpur is slowly becoming an IT hub.
review_content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is good, Wi-Fi labs classes are all decent and well managed. Academically, it has been really great, and all the facilities have been provided. A sports ground has been made, although it is not in use as of now, and the ground is said to be used for football and cricket mainly. Mess food is a bit lower than okayish, not much to be expected, okay for survival.

reviews_list.batch_info: Discontinued(Nov 2025)-B.Tech. in Civil Engineering - Batch of 2026
reviews_list.review_title: If anyone wants to take admission, then first keep these points in your mind.

review_content.Placements: 28.26% of students got placed in the 2024 batch, but I think this year the placement cell will improve because Sunstone Eduversity has taken over this college. 12 LPA is the highest package, 2.4 LPA is the median salary, and for internships, you have to prepare by yourself.
review_content.Infrastructure: Classrooms in this college are like government schools. There are lots of good things also available, like a seminar hall with full AC, some AC classrooms available for postgraduates, and a projector room where the toppers batch of first-year classes were held. The hostel is not so good, and the location of the hostel is in the middle of a forest-type open place. In a short walk, everything is available.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2024
reviews_list.review_title: Placement was provided to each student.

review_content.Placements: I got an 8 CGPA. The highest package was 26 LPA, and the lowest was 5 LPA. Companies like Symphony, Bosch, Mahindra, and HCL visited for placements. 90% of students got internships. The B.Tech courses were good for placements. The placement career counselor gave proper instructions and support.
review_content.Infrastructure: Facilities were very good. Wi-Fi was provided. The classrooms were clean and had ACs. The library was in very good condition with AC classrooms, but there were no digital boards. Filtered and cool water was available. Cleanliness was very good in the classrooms, labs, and library.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering (Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning) - Batch of 2028
reviews_list.review_title: One who is financially weaker and doesn't depend on the college for placement can be admitted to it.

review_content.Placements: 28.26% of students got placed in the 2024 batch, but now the placement cell will improve because Sunstone Eduversity took over my college this year. 12 LPA is the highest package, 2.4 LPA is the median salary, and for internships, you have to prepare yourself and not depend on the college.
review_content.Infrastructure: Class of this college is like government schools. Wooden benches are provided for second-year students onwards. Only for first-year students of the toppers batch were AC facilities available in this college. Library facilities are available, but you have to pay extra monthly charges to sit in the library. Some games were held in the first year only.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Electrical Engineering - Batch of 2024
reviews_list.review_title: Average campus life and academics.

review_content.Placements: Placements for 2021-2024 batch are still on (60% of students have placed so far). The highest package is around 6.5 LPA. Computer Science Engineering. Computer Science Engineering (CSE) is one of the best courses in engineering dealing with the design, development, and maintenance of software, hardware, and networks. Other courses are mechanical engineering, civil engineering, electrical engineering, and biomedical engineering.
review_content.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi is a common facility available for students but Wi-Fi does not work properly. Labs are not equipped with modern equipment to provide students with practical experience in science, technology, engineering, and mathematics. The quality of facilities is average not so bad.

paragraphs: Jawaharlal Nehru Technological University, Anantapur admission 2025will open soon.JNTUAadmission is both entrance and merit-based depending on the course. The university provides undergraduate, postgraduate and doctoral-level programmes via its associated colleges. To get admission to either course provided by the university, students need to qualify for the exam with a valid score. The university invites students selected based on entrance exam scores for counselling. Interested students can read the following article to learn about the courses, eligibility, fees, scholarship, and admission procedure of JNTUA.

JNTUA offers programmes in various fields, such as Management, Engineering, Pharmacy, Technology, Arts, Commerce, and more. These courses are offered across multiple specialisations through the many affiliated colleges of the university. Students can check out the following table to learn about the admission highlights for Jawaharlal Nehru Technical University Anantpur:

JNTUA course admissionto all the courses is subject to a valid score in the national/state-level entrance exam along with the fulfilment of the minimum eligibility criteria set by the college. Furthermore, students must participate in the respective counselling for seat allotment. The admissions are based on national-level entrance tests, such as TS EAMCET, AP PGECET, AP ICET, JEE Main, JEE Advanced, GATE, etc. Aspirants can check out the following table to know about the eligibility and selection criteria forJawaharlal Nehru Technical University courses:

JNTUA feeusually ranges from INR 30,000 to INR 4 lakh. The university fee includes multiple components including, special service fees, placement cells, registration, recognition fees, etc. Students must pay the admission fee to confirm their seats at the university. The fee varies depending on the course and specialisation selected by the students. Interested students can check out the table below to know aboutJNTUA fees:

Jawaharlal Nehru Technical University Anantapur offers seats through its various affiliated colleges and the university campus. The seat intake may vary depending on the course and specialisation selected by the students. Students must participate in the counselling for seat allotment. Aspirants can check out theJNTUA seat intakein the following table:

The admission process at JNTUA follows a set procedure every year. It involves an application process, shortlisting of students, release of merit list, counselling, and seat allotment. Below are the details of each stage of the admission process:1. To take admission to the courses offered at JNTUH, students are required to visit the official website of the respective national-level entrance exam conducting bodies. They need to fill out the application form in online mode.
For the remaining programme students are required to apply directly from the official website of JNTUA.

2. Jawaharlal Nehru Technological University Hyderabad (JNTUH) creates a shortlist of students based on their scores in the respective accepted entrance exams, such as TS EAMCET, GATE, GPAT, etc. The state-level exam conducting bodies, such as TS ICET, release course-wise merit lists for MBA and MCA courses, whereas the university itself releases a merit list for courses based on merit or national-level exams.

3. Once the merit list is released, eligible students are invited for counselling rounds. For MBA and MCA courses, the counselling is overseen by the Telangana State Council of Higher Education (TSCHE), which is known as the TS ICET Counselling. Similarly, for admission to the BTech program, theTS EAMCET Counsellingis held.
4. As per the round of counselling, seats are allotted to the eligible students. Further, the selected students can confirm their admission by paying the course fees.
lists: BTech/ BPharm aspiring students can apply for the programme on the official website of TS EAMCET.
For the MTech/ MSc programme, the students are required to register on the official website of TS PGECET.
For MBA programme, students must register on the official website of AP ICET or TSCIET.

paragraphs: BAU Ranchi admissionsare primarily entrance-based. The university conducts an entrance exam for admission to PG and doctoral courses. For UG programmes, the universityCombined Competitive Entrance Examinationconductedby I.C.A.R. V.C.I.at All India level and through theJharkhand Combined Competitive Entrance Examination Board. Birsa Agricultural University offers UG, PG and doctoral courses in multiple streams such as Agriculture, Science, Veterinary, etc. Interested candidates can apply online on the official website of BAU.

Birsa Agricultural University admission cycle begins inMaywith the opening of registration. Candidates can visit the official website of the university to apply for the preferred course. Below are keyBAU Ranchi admissionhighlights:

Birsa Agricultural University admissions are based on entrance exam score. The minimum eligibility for all UG courses is Class 12 whereas, graduation is required to apply for PG programmes. Below are eligibility and selection criteria for topBAU Ranchi courses:

Birsa Agriculture University admissions are based on university or state-level entrance exams. Candidates need to fulfil all the eligibility and selection requirements to apply for admission. Below is step-wise BAU Ranchi admission process:
STEP 1: BAU Ranchi Application Process 2025

Aspirants can download the application form online from the university website and submit it along with the specified documents and a non-refundable application fee of INR 1,500 (INR 750 for SC/ ST) for PG courses.
STEP 2: Selection

The university selects candidates for UG courses throughCombined Competitive Entrance Examination conducted by I.C.A.R. V.C.I.andJharkhand Combined Competitive Entrance Examination Board, Ranchi. The university conducts an entrance exam for PG and doctoral courses. The university prepares a merit list based on entrance test. The minimum cutoff marks for PG courses is 50% for General/ EWS/ OBC and 40% for SC/ ST/ PC)
STEP 3: Seat Allotment & Admission Confirmation

Once the selection is over, candidates are offered a seat in their preferred course.15%of the total seats are filled by a Combined Competitive Entrance Examination conducted by I.C.A.R. V.C.I. at All India level and85%of the total seats are filled by Jharkhand Combined Competitive Entrance Examination Board, Ranchi. For PG courses, the seats are offered based on the entrance exam conducted by the university. About 50% of the seats are reserved for students belonging from Jharkhand. Selected candidates need to pay course fee to confirm their seat in the university.

reviews.review_heading: I would say that please use funds in the improvement of college, not improvement of own your houses.
reviews.review_text: The college is too old and hasn't undergone renovation. The hostel rooms are so small, 4 people are staying in 1 room in the girls' hostel, which is not good. The lab equipment is either not working or missing, and there are no medical facilities for students. The classrooms are also dirty. It's not so good what I'll say.

reviews.review_heading: Ranchi Agriculture College has good campus environment.
reviews.review_text: There is a Wi-Fi-enabled library with more than 20,00 books and daily newspapers in both English and Hindi. There are football and cricket grounds and basketball and badminton courts. Classrooms have smartboards and Wi-Fi. Labs are equipped with all the accessories and Wi-Fi. The campus has its hospital with basic amenities. Canteens and mess are available.

reviews.review_heading: BAU glance and its functioning.
reviews.review_text: This college has a decent infrastructure, college is equipped with Wi-Fi and has a well-maintained library which is open till 10 pm for boys and 8 pm for girls. Hostel infrastructure is bad, there is a scarcity of single rooms in boy's hostels and the same in girls' hostels. But the hostel fee is very less so it is adjustable.

reviews.review_heading: Overall Good to prepare for future competitive exams.
reviews.review_text: Whole college has Wi-Fi with fast secure internet. There labs as well but don't have enough equipment which are necessary. Library is well maintained and have enough books for a whole batch for courses as well as competitive exam. Hostel is free of cost but mess is having charge.

reviews.review_heading: I am satisfied with this college.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our college is good. Our college provides us with all facilities. A gymnasium is available in our college. The food served in the mess is good. The ambulance is available 24X7. Our college has good security. The library has many books, journals, biographies, and tour experiences written by our seniors and professors. Our college is Wi-Fi enabled. Classrooms are equipped with air-conditioners, smart boards, and projectors.

reviews.review_heading: Good but Improvement required in the recruitment of teaching faculty.
reviews.review_text: Library facilities with free Wi-Fi, computers and Xerox facilities are available. Classrooms are equipped with smartclasses for smooth teaching. Plenty of labs available. Our hostels are equipped with gym, sports complex and the quality of food in our mess is decent. Medical facilities with ambulance are easily available. Every year annual sports meet is conducted.

reviews.review_heading: It is the best college for UG and PG courses.
reviews.review_text: Our college provides good facilities like a hostel, Wi-Fi, etc. The lab should get improved. Medical facilities are not good. An ambulance is available in our college. You cannot play games in our college. A first aid box is available in our college. For any emergency, you have to book a van or auto because there is no driver in our college.

reviews.review_heading: I am dissatisfied with the reduced number of faculty members and the lack of placements.
reviews.review_text: It has one of the best infrastructures among the government institutes. There is a well-managed hostel with better facilities. Sports facilities are available. A good playground on which two games can be played at a time is available. There are air-conditioned lecture halls.

reviews.review_heading: Ranchi veterinary college, single government college in Jharkhand for pursuing veterinary course.
reviews.review_text: The facilities in the college laboratory are good and below average. Hostels are well maintained with spacious rooms, tables, chairs, cupboards, beds, etc. Each hostel has mess facilities with a canteen in boys' hostel.

reviews.review_heading: Great teachers have experience in practical but there is lack of teachers in our college.
reviews.review_text: Everything in the hostel and college is up to the mark. Our hostel and college have Wi-Fi. The labs are well-equipped with chemicals and proper materials which we require in the laboratory. The library contains our course-related and other useful books. The hostel is well-equipped with generator, washing machine, RO water purifier, and well maintained and hygienic hostel.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Birsa Agricultural University.
reviews.review_text: Classroom is well maintained with a smart class, laboratory facility and all types of machinery are available in the department. All the facilities are available at the hostel like a generator, fully furnished rooms with attached bathroom, refrigerator, water cooler, etc. In some hostels, there are air-conditioners also.

reviews.review_heading: Our college is for advancement in life.
reviews.review_text: Our college provides a Wi-Fi facility all over campus, mainly in classrooms, a lab, hostel, library, and courtyard. It provides high-tech equipment in labs. Classrooms are fully digital. The library has all the books. The quality of food served in a mess and canteen is good. It provides all outdoor and indoor games. We have a good temporary sick room for an emergency.

reviews.review_heading: Dissatisfied because of placement area.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is only available for M.Sc.  student here. Hostels are good in condition. Library have a good amount of books. Labs are not in good condition. Mess is private and works by their own rules. Food quality is average. Medical facilities are not available. Sports and games event done by the students .

reviews.review_heading: It is a college for agriculturists.
reviews.review_text: In facilities, we have Wi-Fi all over the campus, mainly in classrooms, labs, hostel, library and courtyard. We have high tech equipment in labs, and classrooms are fully digital and sophisticated. The library has hard books and books. Food quality in the mess and canteen is good.

placement_data.title: Delhi Institute of Advanced Studies Placement Overview 2024
paragraphs: Delhi Institute of Advanced Studies has released the placement stats for the Class of 2024 . As per the latest report, the highest package offered to MBA students during Delhi Institute of Advanced Studies placements 2024 stood at INR 12 LPA . The average package offered to the batch 2024 was ranged between INR 5 LPA and INR 6 LPA . The top recruiters of Delhi Institute of Advanced Studies in 2024 included Infoedge, Amazon, Indigo, HCL, Ameriprise Financial, IDFC First Bank, Amanzi Technologies, CICI Securities, etc.

The MBA batch 2023 comprises 44 students, of whom 38 students opted for placements, of which 37 were placed in reputed companies. The highest and average package offered during Delhi Institute of Advanced Studies placements 2023 stood at INR 11.02 LPA and INR 4.5 LPA, respectively .

reviews.review_heading: Feels a little high than IITs though it is a central government college.
reviews.review_text: Hostels are pretty good. They have provided spacious rooms, clean and the finest. There are proper facilities of Wi-Fi and library, IIT-type classrooms. Labs are fully equipped with machines and instruments. One best thing is the good mess food quality. It feels like homemade food. There are also sports facilities of all kinds, including indoor games.

reviews.review_heading: Not very satisfied, but I did not have any other option, so it's okay to study here.
reviews.review_text: The hostel is new, and the facilities are great at the Amethi campus. Food is decent, and labs are fully equipped, but the library is small for the crowd. Now, talking about the Bangalore Campus, the hostel is very new, but there are no good facilities at all. Wi-Fi is horrible here compared to the Amethi campus. Connectivity is okay at Amethi, but at Bangalore, it's very far from the city.

reviews.review_heading: College is great, but it has a small campus, and the location is quite far from the city.
reviews.review_text: There are outdoor and indoor games in the college with well and good infrastructure. The campus is clean and tidy. It also has a beautiful garden and a statue. There are two academic blocks, and every kind of lab is available in the college.

reviews.review_heading: Not at all satisfied, poor.
reviews.review_text: Construction is still ongoing on and only two academic blocks are there. Wi-Fi doesn't work properly even after complaining a lot they don't fix it. Library is good and classrooms are good too but still, there's a need for more enhancement. Talking about the hostel even after a hefty amount they clean our room only once in 15 days. Wi-Fi is very poor. Medical facilities are the worst in the name of health center, all they have is bitadine and cotton.

reviews.review_heading: Beyond rankings, a realistic look at the Rajiv Gandhi Institute of Petroleum Technology RGIPT.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure and hostel facilities are good at RGIPT. Wi-Fi connections are average, but laboratories and classrooms are best for the petroleum domain. The space in hostel rooms is good, and the mess food is above average. The canteen is open until 3 AM. Sports and medical facilities are less than average and not that good.

reviews.review_heading: College placements are good for the Chemical and Petroleum branches.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi facility is available everywhere, including classrooms, the library, and hostel rooms. Each classroom has an AC and a projector for teaching. Each hostel room accommodates two students and has two fans. Each floor has washing machines. The mess food is good. The night canteen starts at 10 p.m. and is affordable. There is a health center on our college campus.

reviews.review_heading: Good infrastructure and facilities .
reviews.review_text:
Wi-Fi in classrooms and hostels, library (9 AM - 12 AM), and state-of-the-art labs (drilling technology, production engineering, reservoir engineering, geology, well testing, and logging lab).
Sports facilities: volleyball, basketball, football, lawn tennis, badminton, table tennis, carrom, snooker, cricket.

reviews.review_heading: Talented students excel through personal efforts.
reviews.review_text: Labs, classrooms, and overall infrastructure are decent. Hostels are functional and above average. Mess food is edible, it's repetitive, and sometimes below expectations. The campus is small but sufficient. It lacks recreational space, making student life less dynamic.

reviews.review_heading: The Farzi and average IIT.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi quality is good, which is available 24 hours, and library access is for 15 hours. Classroom infrastructure is basic. The canteen is not so good, but the mess food is good. Sports facilities are also good, and the college gives free-of-cost medical treatment. Labs are basic, not so advanced. Wi-Fi speed is not so fast.

reviews.review_heading: This college is not for teach branches.
reviews.review_text: Free Wi-Fi is available. There are 2 or 3 washing machines on each floor. A floor consists of 30-35 rooms. The rooms are quite spacious and in good condition. Food quality is so-so and the canteen is also there. A cafe is also inside the campus. For small injuries, there is a medical center, and of course, it is free of cost. Sports facilities need to be improved.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely good college, RGIPT - an evolving institute comparable to IITs.
reviews.review_text: Facilities available are good rooms, good LAN and Wi-Fi connection, and good classrooms with projectors. Two-seater rooms are provided with one table, one chair, one cot, and one almirah to every student. There is a health centre, cafeteria, and canteen inside the college. Mess food is good, with a gala dinner held once in a month.

reviews.review_heading: Good infrastructure and facilities.
reviews.review_text:
Wi-Fi is available across the college.
Labs are well maintained with working equipment, and classroom infrastructure is very nicely designed. 
The library is full of books, and from time to time new books are added.
Hostel consists of A, B, C, D, E, F, G, and H blocks, and mess food is good, and the night canteen is available for students who study late at night. 
Medical facilities are very good. The campus itself has a health center and ambulance facilities for emergency cases. Sports and game...

reviews.review_heading: Not satisfied with placements.
reviews.review_text: The hostel's Wi-Fi speed is okay, but sometimes the Wi-Fi doesn't work at all. The college infrastructure is better than many NITs. The library is okay but small for the number of students in the college. There is a health centre on campus, but no proper football or cricket ground.

reviews.review_heading: My college is the best in infrastructure. Many sports festivals are held in my college.
reviews.review_text: College infrastructure is very good. Their Wi-Fi and labs are very well. Classrooms are very systematic and have a very good environment. The faculty is the best, and sports are very good with many opportunities. The canteen is good because their food is very tasty.

reviews.review_heading: College is best, and its infrastructure is good.
reviews.review_text: My college infrastructure is very good. Their Wi-Fi and labs are very well. The classrooms are very systematic and have a very good environment. The faculty is the best, and sports are very good and very opportunity in sports and canteen is good because their food is very tasty.

reviews_list.batch_info: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2021
reviews_list.review_title: The college is fairly average.

review_content.Placements: Approximately 60-70% of the students were placed. The highest package offered was around 3 LPA, and the lowest package was around 1.8 LPA. Companies such as ICICI, IDFC, ICICI Prudential, Torrent Power, Flipkart, etc., came for placement drives. The top roles offered were related to bank and business development.
review_content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of our college is good with sufficient parking and campus areas. Wi-Fi, labs, etc., are available. The classrooms are being renovated. The hostel is available only for female students. The quality of food is average. Sports and games have very good infrastructure.

reviews_list.batch_info: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2022
reviews_list.review_title: It is a good college, and the education is good. But the infrastructure is not much good.

review_content.Placements: About 50% of the students were placed from our course. The highest salary offered in our course was 3 lac per month, and the lowest salary offered was Rs. 25,000 per month. The average salary offered was Rs. 50,000 per month. Top recruiting companies for our course are all multinational companies. Lots of top roles are offered in our course.
review_content.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi facility, labs, classrooms, library, etc., needs are available in our hostel and course. Our college provides separate hostel buildings for both boys and girls. Excellent facilities are provided in the hostel, which makes students comfortable and homely. Well-furnished rooms, spacious dining rooms, hygienic cooking facilities, safe drinking water and required levels of security are the main attracting things about the hostels. Well-built and hygienically maintained college canteen is another best thing of our college. Our college tries to cater to the varying culinary needs of students from different parts of the country. There is a highly functional kitchen, which is extremely popular. A variety of Indian food and snack items are prepared deliciously for students and staff members. The canteen is open from 9:00 am to 5:00 pm.

review_summary.college_name: PSNA College of Engineering and Technology Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Information Technology - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Supportive campus with good placements, strong scholarships and student life.

content.Placements: Around 80% of students got placed through campus placements. The average salary is 4.25 LPA. The highest salary is 11 LPA, and the lowest is around 2.5 LPA. Top companies like TCS, Infosys, Wipro, Accenture, and Capgemini came for placements. About 60% of students got internships in IT companies and startups. Jobs offered include Software Developer Trainee, System Engineer, Analyst, and support roles.
content.Infrastructure: The college has decent infrastructure that helps learning. Classrooms are spacious, labs are useful, Wi-Fi works well, and the library is well-maintained. Hostel facilities are safe and comfortable. The food is hygienic, medical help is available, and sports facilities support both indoor and outdoor games for a balanced student life.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: A good engineering college, and it will be a value-for-money education.

content.Placements: The top recruiting companies are Accenture, ServiceNow, HCL Tech, Tech Mahindra, Kaar Technologies, LTI Mindtree and many more. About 75% of students get placed in our college in the batch of 2025. The top courses offered are IT, CSE, AIDS and cybersecurity.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of Wi-Fi, labs, classrooms and library was good, and on the campus, free Wi-Fi facilities are available. In labs, the systems are all very good. Separate labs are given for each department, and the labs are very comfortable with AC, neat and clean.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: A good place for the right path of career education.

content.Placements: Above 80 per cent of students got placed in our college. The highest salary package offered by our college is 44 LPA. It provides various placement training, but one or two training will be paid training, but it will be very useful. The top roles offered in my college are cybersecurity, artificial intelligence and data science.
content.Infrastructure: The college hostel infrastructure is really good. The lab facilities and Wi-Fi facilities are all available in our college. In our library, free Wi-Fi is available, and the food will be of such quality and hygienic that there will be veg and non-veg provided in the mess and also the canteen.

individual_reviews.course: M.E. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2020
individual_reviews.title: Teachers are friendly. It provides good placements.

content.Placements: The top recruiting companies for our course are Google, Infosys, and Accenture. The highest salary package offered is 12 LPA, and the lowest salary package offered is 4 LPA. 85% of students got placed. The top roles offered are project manager and software developer. 65% of students got internships.
content.Infrastructure: The college infrastructure is beautiful. Classrooms are also good. Labs are well-equipped with air conditioning. It has high-speed internet connectivity. Many technical and financial books are available in the library. The hostel facilities are good with an attached bathroom. The canteen is also available. Medical facilities are good.

individual_reviews.course: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2022
individual_reviews.title: Absolutely best and great college.

content.Placements: 90% of students got placed. The highest salary package offered was 10 LPA, and the lowest salary package offered was 3 LPA. Top recruiting companies were Amazon and Wipro. Top roles offered were marketing management and management consulting. 62% of students got internships.

admission_process.title: PSNA College of Engineering and Technology Admission Process 2025

paragraphs: PSNA College of Engineering and Technology admission 2025is primarily based on theentrance exam. The college accepts state-level entrance exams such as TANCET for MBA and MTech, and TNEA for admission to the BTech programme.PSNA College of Engineering and Technologyoffers four courses in affiliation withAnna Universityat UG and PG levels in multiple streams like Engineering, Management and Computer Applications streams. Interested candidates must meet the eligibility criteria before applying to their desired course.

PSNA College of Engineering and Technology courses are available at undergraduate and postgraduate levels. The number of courses offered is four and they are offered in the field of Engineering, Management and Computer Applications. Candidates seeking admission atPSNA College of Engineering and Technologyare required to meet the eligibility criteria of their desired course before applying. The table below shows the eligibility and selection criteria of thePSNA College of Engineering and Technology courses:
Bachelor's degree with at least 50% aggregate (45% aggregate for reserved category)

PSNA College of Engineering and Technology admission process is a multi-step process that begins with the release of application forms followed by shortlisting candidates based on the course-specific admission criteria and then acceptance of the admission offer by the candidates.
The step-wisePSNA College of Engineering admission processis given below:
Step 1: Application process:

Candidates seeking admission at PSNA College of Engineering and Technology, are required to apply for their desired course after meeting the course-specific eligibility criteria. The aspirants need to do so before the stipulated date and pay the required application fee. Students can also check the detailedPSNA College of Engineering and Technology feestructure here.
Step 2: Selection Rounds:

To shortlist candidates, the college accepts state-level entrance exams such as TANCET for MBA and MTech, and TNEA for admission to the BTech programme. Candidates must perform well in the entrance exams to get shortlisted for admission at PSNA College of Engineering and Technology.
Step 3: Final Admission:
The selected candidates will have to confirm their admission by paying the admission confirmation fee and visiting the college campus for the document verification process.

review_summary.college_name: YMCA UST Faridabad Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Reality of My College Satyug Darshan.

content.Placements: Placements are not that good. You have to seek companies by yourself. The highest package I have seen is 6 LPA, which was scored by our senior through referral, and the college provided a package of 3.5 LPA. The top roles that were offered were BD Executive and Sales Junior.
content.Infrastructure: Facilities and infrastructure in the college are good, but the college can improve the facilities for students. Present facilities include AC classrooms and Wi-Fi-enabled labs, and the library has books. The hostel is good, but it is far from the college. Mess and canteen food are not that good.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: My honest opinion about SDIET.

content.Placements: The placement is okay. There is no active placement cell support, and they don’t have a committee for placement assistance. The highest package, which was scored by the college, was between 4 and 5 LPA. Top recruiting companies are Telus, Talbros, Crack-ED, Car Dekho, and Wipro.
content.Infrastructure: Classrooms are quite good. They have facilities like AC classrooms. The library is extensive, yet it doesn’t have books other than the curriculum. The canteen is good, but prices are quite high. The hostel has good facilities, but the building is small, and the quality of food is acceptable, with a different menu every day.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science Engineering (Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning) - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: The best college for a technical course.

content.Placements: In my course, mostly 70% of students get placement. The highest package offered is 21 LPA, and the average package is 5 LPA. Top recruiting companies are Zomato, Microsoft, Wipro, and LinkedIn. Top roles offered by the companies are telecalling, web development, data analysis, and purchase assistance.
content.Infrastructure: College infrastructure is so good, there are clean classes, well-hygiene washrooms, and an RO water service facility. There is Wi-Fi available in all classes, and the seminar halls are wide and have enough space for 200 students to be seated at once. Also, there are clean corridors.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Good in infrastructure, syllabus, and they conduct excellent training every semester.

content.Placements: Well, it's better not to hope for even a single percent from this college, as barely anyone gets selected on campus because barely any companies come, and even if they do, they pay too little. There is no such top recruiting company. If I named them, everybody would say they have heard about this company for the first time, and it’s too hard to find them on Google, too. The top role offered in my course is web development.
content.Infrastructure: Well, I will say that in terms of infrastructure, this is the best. It's so goated that multiple movies, web series, and ads are being shot here. Classrooms are well-equipped with centralized AC, smart boards, speakers, and Wi-Fi. The library is also well-spaced and has a lot of books and quite a space to study. The hostel is also the best according to infrastructure, and the mess food, I would say, is okayish. Hostels have good Wi-Fi and hot and cold showers, and a sports ground.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Computer Applications (BCA) - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: YMCA has a really good infrastructure, and teaches how to live.

content.Placements: My course is BCA Computer Applications, which is related to AI. The students are required to have above 80 percent for a well-seated option in the YMCA. The highest package is 9-12 LPA, and the minimum is 3 - 5 LPA. The companies recruiting are mostly Wipro, Accenture, and many etc.
content.Infrastructure: The college has a great infrastructure, as I see when I get into the electrical department. The department was so fully elegantly designed looks like a theatre room. The qualities of the hostel are also very good, girls have their own hostel building, which depicts a secure environment.

hostel_campus.college_name: YMCA UST Faridabad Infrastructure Details & Reviews

hostel.description: The University has a total number of 7 hostels, 4 for boys and 4 for girls. One reading room in each boys’ and girls’ hostel with newspapers and magazines. Shift canteen in the girls' hostel.  One common room in the girls’ hostel and two common rooms in the boys’ hostel with LED TVs.  Wi-Fi facility and water coolers fitted with RO are provided.  Guest room in girls’ hostel for female relatives of students. The Boy’s Hostel will be allotted to only first year and second year students only. The hostel will not be allotted to 3rd year, 4th year & PG boy’s students.  Hostel will be allotted on First come first basis.

library.description: The University Library building has a total area of 7200 sq. ft. It has two Reading Halls with a total capacity of 155 seats. University Library has a rich collection of more than 76 thousand volumes in the stream of Engineering & Technology, applied sciences and Management. The library is also subscribing 104 Print Journals, 6365 E-journals, 701+ E-books, 40 Magazines, 16 Newspapers and 138 CD ROMs (excluding Book CDs). It is well equipped with modern technology like Internet, Bar Code technology etc. The library is automated with the Library Automation Software Libsys. Every member has been provided a Bar Coded Library Membership Card. Online Public Access Catalogue (OPAC) is available to locate the reading material in the library. The library is the member of DELNET and E-Shodhsindhu Consortium. The library having subscription of e-resources from SpringerLink, Taylor and Francis, Nature, Economic & Political Weekly, JSTOR, Oxford University Press, ASME, McGraw-Hill Access Engineering, Science Direct(Engg & Computer Science collection), World e-book Library and Asian Archive.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2026Offered by Satyug Darshan Institute of  Engineering and TechnologyReviewed on 22 Jan 2026)
reviews.review_heading: Reality of My College Satyug Darshan.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure in the college are good, but the college can improve the facilities for students. Present facilities include AC classrooms and Wi-Fi-enabled labs, and the library has books. The hostel is good, but it is far from the college. Mess and canteen food are not that good.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2027Offered by Satyug Darshan Institute of  Engineering and TechnologyReviewed on 22 Jan 2026)
reviews.review_heading: My honest opinion about SDIET.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms are quite good. They have facilities like AC classrooms. The library is extensive, yet it doesn’t have books other than the curriculum. The canteen is good, but prices are quite high. The hostel has good facilities, but the building is small, and the quality of food is acceptable, with a different menu every day.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2027Offered by Echelon Institute of TechnologyReviewed on 20 Jan 2026)
reviews.review_heading: The best college for a technical course.
reviews.review_text: College infrastructure is so good, there are clean classes, well-hygiene washrooms, and an RO water service facility. There is Wi-Fi available in all classes, and the seminar halls are wide and have enough space for 200 students to be seated at once. Also, there are clean corridors.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2027Offered by Echelon Institute of TechnologyReviewed on 18 Jan 2026)
reviews.review_heading: Good in infrastructure, syllabus, and they conduct excellent training every semester.
reviews.review_text: Well, I will say that in terms of infrastructure, this is the best. It's so goated that multiple movies, web series, and ads are being shot here. Classrooms are well-equipped with centralized AC, smart boards, speakers, and Wi-Fi. The library is also well-spaced and has a lot of books and quite a space to study. The hostel is also the best according to infrastructure, and the mess food, I would say, is okayish. Hostels have good Wi-Fi and hot and cold showers, and a sports ground.

reviews.review_heading: YMCA has a really good infrastructure, and teaches how to live.
reviews.review_text: The college has a great infrastructure, as I see when I get into the electrical department. The department was so fully elegantly designed looks like a theatre room. The qualities of the hostel are also very good, girls have their own hostel building, which depicts a secure environment.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2025Offered by Echelon Institute of TechnologyReviewed on 14 Jan 2026)
reviews.review_heading: It is an excellent college with good and experienced faculty members.
reviews.review_text: The college has good infrastructure with greenery. The size of the campus is very large. Hostels are also available that are separate for both boys and girls. Wi-Fi connectivity is also available, but it is only in the academic block and is weaker in hostels. The overall ecosystem promotes focused learning.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2024Offered by Echelon Institute of TechnologyReviewed on 14 Jan 2026)
reviews.review_heading: It has a modern cinematic campus with easy academics.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is super modern and better than that of other colleges in Faridabad. It is so good that web series and ads are often shot here. We have everything like Wi-Fi, great labs, a gym, and a sports room. It offers hostels for both boys and girls. The only thing missing is a swimming pool.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely dissatisfied with the campus and placements.
reviews.review_text: There  is no boys hostel provided by the university to the male students, only the girls hostel is present so I do not know much about it. The infrastructure is okay, it has a pretty good library where every book is available, and Wi-Fi also works well.

reviews.review_heading: If I have to summarize my college, it is good and I love my college.
reviews.review_text: Our college is full of facilities, which makes my college life very good. I enjoy my college life a lot and it is a very good college. The infrastructure is also good, and I like this college very much. If I talk about my college quality, then its quality in each term is nice.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2029Offered by Satyug Darshan Institute of  Engineering and TechnologyReviewed on 3 Dec 2025)
reviews.review_heading: It has strong academics and supportive faculty members.
reviews.review_text: Our college provides a library, a gymnasium, a sports complex, and multiple laboratories for practical work. It also has an auditorium, a cafeteria, Wi-Fi, and transportation services. There are hostels with separate accommodation for both boys and girls with a Wi-Fi facility.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2029Offered by Shri Ram College of Engineering and ManagementReviewed on 1 Dec 2025)
reviews.review_heading: Greatly disappointed by the college faculty.
reviews.review_text: The college is small. The labs are good, but the computers are of average quality. The library has a good quantity of books. No Wi-Fi facility. The food is good, but there is no facility for sports. The playground is too small. The auditorium hall is also very small. The equipment in the laboratory is useless and needs to be repaired. The benches are satisfied. The bathroom has broken seats. It does not provide good drinking water.

reviews.review_heading: Overall academic wise good.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is good. Hostels are only for girls. No hostel for boys. Maintenance is on work. Canteen is available there. And food is of very good quality and food variety is also available. Ground is much bigger than you think. You can play many games.

reviews.review_heading: The college is the 2nd-best college in Haryana after NIT Kuk in B.Tech course.
reviews.review_text: The university offers modern infrastructure, Wi-Fi-enabled campus, smart classrooms, well- equipped departmental labs (e.g., computer, electronics, mechanical), and a rich library with more than 76000 volumes plus e-resources. Hostel accommodation is available.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2027Offered by Echelon Institute of TechnologyReviewed on 25 Nov 2025)
reviews.review_heading: The perfect hub of technology .
reviews.review_text: The college infrastructure is overall good for Students. Our department has well-equipped labs, working project tools, smart classrooms, Wi-Fi access, and a decent library with enough books for reference. The hostel facilities are also satisfactory with clean rooms, drinking water, and proper security.

reviews.review_heading: College is decent with decent placement.
reviews.review_text: The university offers modern infrastructure: Wi-Fi enabled campus smart classrooms and a rich library with more than 76000 volumes plus e resources. Hostel accommodation includes separate boys and girls hostels with a reading room RO water coolers.

review_summary.college_name: College of Arts and Commerce Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: M.A. in History - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: My honest review about my college.

content.Placements: Very good placement in our college. Top companies are coming to our college. Placement is very good at the top companies like TCS, Wipro, HCL, Tata Motors, and Chat company. 500 students have been selected for Infosys, IoN TCS, and Innova. Students are very happy to be selected in NDA campus placement but the civil engineering students or not court the campus centre has been not selected.
content.Infrastructure: Hostel facilities are not so good in terms of food, room but it is now improving a lot. We got Wi-Fi recently.

individual_reviews.course: Master of Human Resource Management (MHRM) - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Honest review of my college.

content.Placements: This college guarantees placements in Wipro, HCL, Tech Mahindra, Infosys, LG, Godrej, etc., with a basic salary of Rs. 25,000 per month. Last year, out of 200 students, 152 were placed in good jobs. For the project works they are offering 10-15 thousand rupees. The campus recruitments are regularly done by Wipro, HCL, Tech Mahindra, Infosys, LG, Godrej, etc.
content.Infrastructure: College itself has very helpful people and it could use some good management processes. The management and delays in work make students confused. The college has a good lab facility which made me more enthusiastic. The hostel atmosphere is very homely and pollution-free. We have friendly wardens. Ragging is strictly prohibited and the rooms are maintained neatly. We are involved in the Watch Barath programs. For the hostels, they are charging Rs. 36,000 per year.

individual_reviews.course: M.A. in History - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: Review of College of Arts and Commerce, Andhra University, Visakhapatnam.

content.Placements: There are very few people placed at that time. Without accommodation and food, they offer 1 lakh per annum. Bangalore companies came to campus: Silverton, Cementrics, Miracle, Yelamanchali. Some BPO companies also visited and selected a few students, offering them very low stipends.
content.Infrastructure: Various courses are offered at the college, and the faculty is simply amazing. All my teachers were very helpful and motivating. They provide not only theoretical knowledge but also teach lessons useful for life. All the teachers are brilliant. They are masters in their fields, yet very down-to-earth and always available to help. My college days were truly special because of my teachers. The college does not provide hostels, but I live in Civil Lines, Jabalpur, where many hostels are charging around 4,000 Rs. and are in very good condition. Students stay comfortable.

individual_reviews.course: M.A. in Applied Economics - Batch of 2023
individual_reviews.title: I am absolutely dissatisfied with facilities.

content.Placements: The percentage of students who get placed in my course is 45%. The highest package is 7.5 LPA and the average package is 4 LPA. The lowest package is 3 LPA. Very few companies reach our institute for recruitment. Few students got internships.
content.Infrastructure: The furniture of labs and classrooms is getting very old. Technologies like projectors and computers are also getting outdated. The quality of food available in the mess and canteen is very hygienic and very few varieties. The hostel rooms are not comfortable.

individual_reviews.course: M.A. in Economics - Batch of 2023
individual_reviews.title: It has very bad infrastructure and facilities.

content.Placements: Very few students get placed in our course. About 40% of students get placed in our course. The highest package is 7 LPA, and the average package is 4.5 LPA. The lowest package is 3.5 LPA. Few students got internships here.
content.Infrastructure: The condition of washrooms and toilets is very bad. The urinals and separation walls are broken, and there is no supply of water at taps. The college campus is not clean. The chalkboards and whiteboards are broken. The quality of food available in the mess and canteen is not acceptable.

The school accepts CMAT, CAT, KMAT, etc. scores for admission to specific courses.DCSMAT Idukkioffers courses at UG, PG and doctoral levels in affiliation withMahatma Gandhi University, Kottayam. Interested candidates can apply online for the preferred course.

DCSMAT offers admission to candidates based on their merit in the qualifying exam or entrance exam scores. Aspirants must fulfil the minimum qualification requirements to apply for a course. DCSMAT admissions are currently open for all the courses. Candidates need to apply online for the preferred UG or PG programmes. Below are the steps to get a seat in the school:
STEP 1: DCSMAT Application Process 2025
The mode of application is online. Aspirants need to fill personal, academic and other details in the application form. Candidates also need to pay a course fee to register for the course.
STEP 2: Selection

The school shortlists candidates for UG courses based on their merit in the last qualifying exam. For MBA, candidates need to qualify CAT, CMAT or KMAT. Selected candidates are further called for a GD and PI round.
STEP 3: Admission Confirmation
The school informs the selected candidates via mail or SMS. Aspirants are further required to pay theDCSMAT feeto confirm their seat.

hostel_campus.college_name: DC School of Management and Technology Infrastructure Details & Reviews

reviews.review_heading: Best college for MBA students with good placement offers.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is very good. Three shared dormitories have adequate amenities. Wi-Fi, hot water, and laundry facilities are all accessible. The food is of exceptional quality, and the menu changes on a monthly basis. The library houses a huge assortment of educational materials for students. The women's hostel is a three-story stall and offers a 24/7 Wi-Fi connection.

reviews.review_heading: Serene space to learn Architecture.
reviews.review_text: The hostel is not up to the mark but canteen food is bearable according to other colleges. There are laundry facilities available and also drying rooms are provided in the hostel for drying clothes. There are studio rooms for classes, they are mediocre and can be improved in infrastructure.

reviews.review_heading: Good college for chilling.
reviews.review_text: The college has good infrastructure for all courses, including many classrooms for arts and design, clay workshops, a brick kiln workshop, a football turf, a volleyball ground, a basketball ground, two amphitheaters for entertainment, and an average hostel with subpar bathrooms but a comfortable sleeping climate.

reviews.review_heading: The college hostel feels are low compared to other colleges.
reviews.review_text: The hostel facilities are very good and comfortable. Each room is shared among three people. The rooms are spacious enough for three people with three separate bunk beds that have a table and cupboard attached. Apart from this, there are also three separate cupboards. The washrooms and toilets are all separate and equipped with washing machines. The water facilities are clean and abundant. External Expenses: Rs. 2000 - Rs. 4000.

reviews.review_heading: Feels like our own house.
reviews.review_text: Our college provides computer labs, library only for B.Arch free Wi-Fi all throughout campus and hostel service with grounds. Our college doesnot support sports much, but still has a football ground and volleyball court. Hostels are good but not that great.

reviews.review_heading: I am highly satisfied with this college.
reviews.review_text: This is a residential campus. The library contains a huge collection of books that are helpful for students. The food served at the hostel is better. Wi-Fi facility is available 24X7.

reviews.review_heading: Good college for MBA seekers.
reviews.review_text: It has a triple sharing bedroom with good facilities providing. It have Wi-Fi, warm water etc. And also providing laundry services.3 floors available for ladies hostel also having Wi-Fi services 24*7. Food is very good monthly changing menus. Daily one time non veg is available.

reviews.review_heading: Our campus is very beautiful.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is very good. Hostel facilities are decent. The food served in the canteen is delicious. Medical facilities are average. Sports and games are conducted.

reviews.review_heading: It is the best college in Kerala.
reviews.review_text: In our college, both boys' and girls' hostels are closed. Facilities and infrastructure are good. Our campus is very beautiful. It also provides a library, and multi-level computer laboratories are also available. Workshops for architecture students are also conducted. The canteen is clean, and the food quality is better.

reviews.review_heading: I am satisfied with its 100% placements. It provides good infrastructure and facilities.
reviews.review_text: The canteen was good, and the food price was reasonable. Our college was also equipped with basic gym facilities. The infrastructure of our college was very good for study with all modern facilities like conference rooms, a Wi-Fi campus, and a library with all good books related to the curriculum. The hostel was also good.

reviews.review_heading: It is joyful and very energetic and feels so homely that we all miss campus life, and life together.
reviews.review_text: It has all amenities to make it a good living place. The hostel is very clean and play ground for athletes and cricket lovers, and also a basketball and volleyball court to organize outdoor games. The hostel is spacious and the food quality is very good. Overall it is a nice place and particular who is living outside alone away from their parents, they will feel homely environment.

reviews.review_heading: It is a great experience for life.
reviews.review_text: The food quality is good. The campus atmosphere is good. A stationery store, beauty parlour, cafe, canteen, small shops, etc., are available for students. All are available inside the campus. I had a very good experience.

reviews.review_heading: In DCSMAT, the ROI in terms of knowledge is the best.
reviews.review_text: The ambience of our college is excellent, and our college also has good infrastructural facilities. Canteen facilities provided in DC are good, and other facilities are also good. Vagamon campus has a mini-mart, laundry services, cafeteria, multi-gym, etc.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with the Facilities and Infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: The important facility provided by DCSMAT is the library which provides all kind of books for reference and good classrooms with audiovisual facilities. There is free Wi-Fi and DCSMAT has an intranet through which all the learning materials are available. The hostel facilities are also good. In the hostel, there are 3 sharing and 2 sharing rooms and a mini gym. There is a main gym inside the campus and mini super market facility is also available. DCSMAT also provides good mess and medical facil...

reviews.review_heading: DCSMAT is an average college with a good fee structure and good placements.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms are environment-friendly. The college has one of the largest libraries in Kerala. The campus has a canteen and 2 cafeterias. We have a volleyball court and a basketball court. Hostel rooms are satisfactory. The college is located on hilly terrain. So, there will be some difficulties due to the particular terrain, and we are not at all familiar with that.

review_summary.college_name: Central University of Rajasthan Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. in Environmental Science - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: University is very nice, but not as good.

content.Placements: At CURAJ Environment Science Depth, 30-40 percent of students got placed, while many pursue higher studies. Packages range from 2.5 LPA to 9 LPA, with an average of 4 LPA-5 LPA. Recruiters include Sun Pharma, Cipla, and Reliance. 50-60 percent of students secure internships at CSIR labs, IITs, IISERs, and pharma firms.
content.Infrastructure: The environmental sciences Depth at CURAJ has Wi-Fi, smart classrooms, well-equipped labs, and a central library. Hostels are decent with Wi-Fi, clean rooms, and mess food is average but hygienic, a medical center is available, and good sports facilities for games and fitness.

individual_reviews.course: Integrated B.Sc. + M.Sc. in Biotechnology - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: College is really good, and if you want to pursue Biotechnology, then you should take this one.

content.Placements: Below average student placements are held. It depends on the professor of the particular subject. The maximum package is 7 LPA, but it is heard by someone, you do not have to see the particular person. Companies like Biocon, Serum, Dr. Reddy are visiting. About 55 percent get internships. In M.Sc., they provide internships from the university side, but if you are in B.Sc., you should get internships on your own. Career options include Scientist.
content.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi is good, labs are great, classrooms are well structured, and the library facilities are nice. Hostel facility is good, mess facility is below average, canteen facility is good. Medical facilities are not much good. Sports and games are well, courts and grounds are available in this university.

individual_reviews.course: Integrated B.Sc. + M.Sc. in Environmental Science - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: It has good infrastructure and qualified faculty.

content.Placements: To enroll in this course, we have to give CUET exam and merit is always different. Above 60% achieving students can get internships in companies that need environment consultant. Not sure about the package from my course. Roles offered are environment consultant, environment research, professors, etc.
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is really amazing in departments, but Wi-Fi is rarely available in department. Classrooms are fine with projector fixed and enough storage. Library is also good. Hostels are okay, and food quality depends on tenders. Sports ground is good, and students are also always excited. Sports activities happen every other day.

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. in Environmental Science - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Absolutely satisfied, really.

content.Placements: 70 per cent of students are appearing in this course, 3 lakh to 5 lakh average package, mostly government jobs of officer rank in environmental science and other jobs like teacher and professor, also there are jobs in IT sector in this field, and agricultural jobs.
content.Infrastructure: Proper Wi-Fi is provided by the university, classrooms are good, and there is a central library, a reading room, and also a reading room in the department where students can read in their free time after class. Well, mess with pure vegetarian food, well, the quality of food provided.

individual_reviews.course: Integrated B.Sc. + M.Sc. in Chemistry - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Very satisfied because of the amazing faculty, and the infrastructure and facilities are very good.

content.Placements: In my class, the strength is 30 students. In my department, the highest package is 6-7 LPA. None companies came for recruitment. All students got an internship from my course in medical companies and IITs. The top roles offered is professor, quality control analyst.
content.Infrastructure: Facilities and infrastructure are amazing in my department and hostel. Two floors are occupied by the Chemistry department. Labs are amazing with high-tech boards. Classrooms are very huge with installed AC and speaker. Wi-Fi connectivity is great. Living in the hostel is better, but the food is average; also no variety of food is available in the canteen. Medical facilities are great, an ambulance is also available, and all types of sports and games are available: courts and grounds.

Central University of Rajasthan admission process begins with registration. Candidates are selected for courses such as MTech, MBA, and other PG courses based on CUET-PG scores. For a detailed admission process, check the details below:
STEP 1: CURAJ Application Process 2025

Candidates applying viaCUET-UGandCUET-PGhave to fill out the application form for the respective exam. For other courses, such as BTech, MTech, etc. candidates will have to apply on the official website of the university. The mode of application is online. The registration link is available on the official website of CURAJ.
STEP 2: Selection

Central University of Rajasthan selects candidates for most of the PG courses such as MTech, MBA, MSc, MCom, etc. based onCUET-PG score.CUET-UGis accepted for Integrated BSc-MSc programme. The university also accepts other national-level entrance exams such as GATE, JEE Main, etc. Once the candidates have appeared for CUET-UG and CUET-PG, the university opens counselling registration on the CURAJ Samarth Portal. Aspirants are required to login with their CUET no. and password and fill out the registration form.
STEP 3: Counselling and Admission Confirmation

Candidates seeking admission via entrance exams other than CUET are required to pay the course fee to confirm their seat in the university after selection. CUET applicants are called counselling and seat allotment. As per the preference filled by them and their CUET rank, they are offered seat in various round. Shortlisted aspirants need to pay the course fee to confirm their seat in the university.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied and good infrastructure and facilities.
reviews.review_text: All Wi-Fi, lab, classroom, and infrastructure are totally good. The quality of food is also good, and sports and games are also good. It has a big place. This college has encouraged all cultural activities and sports, also based on our interests. ln library, a lot of books for preparing for GATE, CAT, and competitive exams also.

reviews.review_heading: The college that made my life beautiful.
reviews.review_text: There is no Wi-Fi provided for students, but Wi-Fi is only provided in the labs where the huge computers are available for laptop activities. The classrooms are neat and sufficient for the more than 70 students, a big library is available in our college, and it is not allowed without a student ID card. Quality food is available in our canteen with a neat, clean, and hygienic area. Sports and games, medical facilities, mess, and canteen are all available in our college.

reviews.review_heading: A world full of opportunities.
reviews.review_text: My college provides every basic facility to students, whether in sports, canteen, or medical facilities. Students also actively participate in sports events both inside and outside of the campus. There are gold medalists in sports at my college as well.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied, good and friendly faculty, good placements, good infrastructure, and greenery.
reviews.review_text: Nice infrastructure, library, classroom, labs, computers, provide quality food, available medical facilities, sports, organic farming, good environment, clean and hygienic hostel. Clean rooms and washrooms, provide healthy food, a clean and hygienic mess, and clean surroundings.

reviews.review_heading: Good infrastructure with a green environment and a knowledge faculty.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is very good, and green. There are many labs for students. The food is very healthy and delicious. Wi-Fi is provided. The library has a separate block, and in that block, more than 2000 books are present.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with the infrastructure and faculty.
reviews.review_text: Mind blowing infrastructure and labs are well equipped with good working systems. The internet is also good and the classrooms are also very satisfying. Each classroom has a projector a big sized blackboard and the ventilation is good in the class.

reviews.review_heading: My college atmosphere and infrastructure are really good.
reviews.review_text: Facilities provided are good in our hostel. There will be better Wi-Fi, neat classrooms, and hygienic corridors. There are washrooms in our college. The quality of the hostel is very good. There is a very good atmosphere in our hostel.

reviews.review_heading: Good college for overall development, with opportunities for professional growth
reviews.review_text: We have several labs that are functional, though some may be outdated. Our classrooms are generally decent, and we have Wi-Fi throughout the campus, which is a big plus. The library is a highlight, with a good collection of both traditional books and access to online databases.

reviews.review_heading: I feel very good at this college.
reviews.review_text: Facilities are very much healthy and student-relevant. The infrastructure of both classes and hostels is tidy and maintained in a classical manner. Labs are very well-equipped, and the quality of the food is the best, as for MVGR College.

reviews.review_heading: MVGR College teaches lot of knowledge, skills, enjoyable moments also
reviews.review_text: The classrooms include projectors, CCTV cameras, and Wi-Fi, facilities like library, Wi-Fi, labs, cabins, canteens, and sports complex are available. The quality of the hostel rooms is good, and the quality of the food is also nice. The classrooms are also arranged individually for each section.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Maharaj Vijayaram Gajapathi Raj College of Engineering (MVGRCE)
reviews.review_text: MVGR (Maharaj Vijayaram Gajapathi Raj College of Engineering) offers comprehensive infrastructure. It includes modern, ICT-enabled classrooms with projectors and audio systems. It has well-equipped academic labs, a central and departmental library with a digital library facility. Along with EZ Proxy for e-journals, air-conditioned seminar halls, a data center, and residential facilities.

reviews.review_heading: The better college among neighbouring colleges.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure was very good. Apart from placements, the college is clean and good. The food in the hostel is very nice, and it has so many varieties in the mess. There are both LAN and Wi-Fi facilities in my college and hostel. My department has so many facilities.

reviews.review_heading: Maharaj Vijayaram Gajapati Raj College of Engineering.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and the infrastructure were so good, and the Wi-Fi and department labs are so good. The quality of the food was average, and there are also available stalls like ice cream and baker's choice. There are many varieties that will be available. The facilities of the library were good.

reviews.review_heading: It is an excellent college for every student.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is very good and environment is nature-friendly with a lot of trees. The classrooms are very structured with projector classes. Wi-Fi is available only in labs. We have a big library in our college. We can read and write, and we can also rent library books. I am not a hostler but as much as I know, the quality of food is good. Medical facilities are available anytime during college hours. Sports and games are encouraged depending on the interests of students.

reviews.review_heading: Better for NON IT courses.
reviews.review_text: Our college infrastructure is very nice and has a good atmosphere. The college has Wi-Fi, but it is not shared with students, and classrooms are big, and the library is a very big one, which consists of different types of books. The hostel facility is the best one in our region, which has bigger grounds and better food compared to other hostels in this region.

review_summary.college_name: Northcap University Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: BBA in Business Analytics - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Great college life with a good placement offer.

content.Placements: I must say a full batch of business analytics got placed by university and got an average package of 5 LPA. Almost all the students got a placement if they applied for it, but some students didn't apply for the placement. Our college offers multiple placements and internships in India and abroad, with multiple scholarships and global opportunities.
content.Infrastructure: Great infrastructure with a full Wi-Fi campus and a big enough library with most of the books. Our campus has 3 cafes, one inside the building and two in the garden. Our college has a big ground on which students can play, sit, and roam around, and also the whole university is very clean.

individual_reviews.course: BBA in Digital Marketing - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: The NorthCap University is a very good college for B.Tech. Also, it is good for management.

content.Placements: 85% of students were placed in my college. Top recruiting companies are Amazon, Mitsubishi, and many more. For campus placements, college follows a mock interview if you pass the interview, you are eligible for placements and it depends on you.
content.Infrastructure: The NorthCap University is not that big, and it has around 10 acres of land. The overall infrastructure is good. Classrooms are fully equipped. The library has all the books that are recommended by the teacher. Hostel is also good. One thing I can say is that the food is good and cooked with hygiene.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering (Cyber Security and Forensics) - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: The NorthCap University!

content.Placements: There are a lot of companies that come to our college every year for placement drives like TCS, Infosys, HCL, Deloitte, Tata, and Byju's. The average package ranges from 2.5 LPA to 6 LPA. About 50-60% of the students get campus placement with an average salary.
content.Infrastructure: The college campus is well-equipped with Wi-Fi (we are given 2GB of Wi-Fi, which is kind of less). Our classes are fully air-conditioned with good seating from where the board is clearly visible. The food at the campus is also good with varieties available.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Great Infrastructure and Facilities.

content.Placements: As we are first-year students, we don't know much about the placements, but from what we have heard from our seniors, they genuinely help us in getting our placements done with the right knowledge and provide guidance through each and every step. The top recruiter is Dell for now.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of our college is amazing. It is equipped with all the things needed by a student. The library is updated with books, classrooms have smart boards, and Wi-Fi is provided to each and every student. The canteen is great, providing yummy snacks.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering (Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning) - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Absolutely dissatisfied because of placements. Good infrastructure.

content.Placements: They have a very low placement ratio. They show 70% placement, but in reality, out of 600 students, only 100 are eligible to sit for placements. They have terms and conditions like no active backlogs or no backlog till now, and the companies that come here for hiring are offering very low packages.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is very decent. They don't have any hostel, but the infrastructure is good; they have Wi-Fi at every corner with decent speed. The library is also up to mark. I would say they have the best canteen, in my opinion. The area of the college is small, which is why it has low sports facilities, but it has good medical facilities.

reviews.review_heading: Great college life with a good placement offer.
reviews.review_text: Great infrastructure with a full Wi-Fi campus and a big enough library with most of the books. Our campus has 3 cafes, one inside the building and two in the garden.
