reviews.review_heading: The NorthCap University is a very good college for B.Tech. Also, it is good for management.
reviews.review_text: The NorthCap University is not that big, and it has around 10 acres of land. The overall infrastructure is good. Classrooms are fully equipped. The library has all the books that are recommended by the teacher. Hostel is also good. One thing I can say is that the food is good and cooked with hygiene.

reviews.review_heading: The NorthCap University!
reviews.review_text: The college campus is well-equipped with Wi-Fi (we are given 2GB of Wi-Fi, which is kind of less). Our classes are fully air-conditioned with good seating from where the board is clearly visible. The food at the campus is also good with varieties available.

reviews.review_heading: Great Infrastructure and Facilities.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our college is amazing. It is equipped with all the things needed by a student. The library is updated with books, classrooms have smart boards, and Wi-Fi is provided to each and every student. The canteen is great, providing yummy snacks.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely dissatisfied because of placements. Good infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is very decent. They don't have any hostel, but the infrastructure is good; they have Wi-Fi at every corner with decent speed. The library is also up to mark. I would say they have the best canteen, in my opinion. The area of the college is small, which is why it has low sports facilities, but it has good medical facilities.

reviews.review_heading: Good Infrastructure and Supportive Faculty. Worth a Try!
reviews.review_text: My university has air-conditioned classrooms, a library, a common room, an amphitheater, an auditorium, Wi-Fi facility, a Thought Lab, a Psychology Lab, cafes, a Maggi Point (NESCAFE outlet), and a sports room for indoor sports like chess, carrom, and table tennis. There are also basketball and badminton areas, multiple washrooms, and drinking water facilities on each floor.

reviews.review_heading: Review: The Northcap University.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is available throughout the campus, with air-conditioned classrooms and a large library containing thousands of books. No hostels are available for boys; hostels are only available for girls, and there are limited seats in the hostels. Many games and sports are available, such as cricket.

reviews.review_heading: Choose the right college for you .
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our college is way to good; they provide us with AC classes, perfect benches, comfortable smart boards and a perfect garden, which gets awarded for the best garden award almost most of the time. It also provides us with 2 cafes and 1 Nescafe, providing healthy food and junk food .

reviews.review_heading: Crowd is not good but the faculty is good. The campus is average but small, no hostel for boys.
reviews.review_text: All the classrooms have projectors for better teaching and creative learning. The students use these projectors for delivering presentations too. The Library is good having adequate collection of books. But the Wi-Fi is not that good and only provides 2GB for each student daily, the downloading speed is very good but the browsing speed is slow. There is only a girls hostel which is located 1KM away from the campus and there is no boys hostel available. The food quality is good in the cafes. Medi...

reviews.review_heading: The infrastructure is really good, but it is not good for the sports students.
reviews.review_text: The facilities are good but there are not a lot of things that should be covered in the facilities. The courses are good. They should also provide boys hostel facilities. They only have female hostel facilities. The hostel food is good.

reviews.review_heading: Excellent faculty and infrastructure with great placement opportunities.
reviews.review_text: There are many facilities provided by the universities. Wi-Fi is fully available throughout the campus and labs, classrooms are fully air-conditioned and well-maintained. Libraries are also very clean and fully air-conditioned. The hostel facilities are also very good and the quality of food is also very hygienic.

reviews.review_heading: The Northcap University- Gurgaon.
reviews.review_text: We do not have hostel facilities. Only a girls' hostel is available. Food quality is very average. Wi-Fi and canteen facilities are also available. The taste of food in the canteen is very nice, food tastes like homemade food. Hostel rooms are cleaned every day in the morning.

reviews.review_heading: Strong Industry Connections and Supportive Faculty at The NorthCap University.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi was available and access was given to all. The library is large enough for a perfectly calm study environment. The classrooms are good, with centralized AC all over the campus. The ground is huge, and the cafe facilities are a bit tiring as they don't deal in cash but only with canteen cards.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with the university.
reviews.review_text: Facilities include accommodation for both girls and boys, a health centre, a well-stocked library with both online and sprint resources, a gymnasium, a multipurpose sports ground, a cafeteria, auditorium and well-equipped laboratories. The quality of food in the mess and canteen is decent.

reviews.review_heading: Good college in terms of infrastructure, safety, and facilities. Faculty are helpful and supportive.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure are really nice and well maintained. I am a day scholar, but according to my friends who have told me about hostels, they are not inside the college; they are outside the college, and they are only for girls.

reviews.review_heading: To grow, you need to read and analyse first.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is such appealing to the eye, but the hostel is of very poor quality. The infrastructure of the hostel is good, but the food quality is unbearable. reviews.review_heading: Before paying lakhs, do check the reviews.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is so appealing that the students don't wish to go outside the campus. The hostel is okay, but the food quality is poor; hence, it is not worth it. Even the healthiest can get sick by eating hostel food.

reviews.review_heading: To grow, need to research first.
reviews.review_text: The most attractive part is the infrastructure. The infrastructure is so pleasing and mesmerizing that you tend to get greedy to take admission in this college. reviews.review_heading: Read, go through, then enter.

Sports and extracurricular facilities exist but are not very well-maintained.

reviews_list.review_title: It is a high-rated college, and I suggest students enroll in it.

review_content.Placements: The maximum salary accredited to the students placed in recruitment is 14.8 LPA, and it was the highest one till now in the field of clinical nutrition. Ixcela and Nualtra are frequent recruiters who participate in the recruitment process throughout the academic year. A maximum number of students keep on enrolling in various courses at Sri Ramachandra Institute of Higher Education and Research. However, only a limited number of seats are open for all the disciplines. Seats are allotted based on the merit scores of students.
review_content.Faculty: Teachers sometimes show discrimination among the students. Mostly, this happens at the time of examinations, but they won't corner any students. Slightly they give priority to a few of the top performers. Examinations are somewhat hard to clear because of the tough syllabus.

reviews_list.batch_info: M.Sc. in Clinical Nutrition - Batch of 2021
reviews_list.review_title: I am from the M.Sc. in Clinical Nutrition course.

review_content.Placements: The employability rate was successfully higher throughout the end of the year. Top reputed clinics and some other corporates took part in the placement process of our institution. Some students become entrepreneurs and they start their own ventures.
review_content.Faculty: Semester exams are conducted once in year, but we must study harder from the beginning of the year. The course curriculum contains various topics, and our teachers suggest reference books useful for examinations. We often visit clinics to gain practical work experience. Students from diverse environments and with different goals start doing their courses in our college. Even though we have different goals everyone undergoes the same learning with the same dignity. It is hectic and we do not have any time to play sports. However, we underwent a counseling process under the guidance of teachers.

review_summary.college_name: SRIHER Chennai Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering (Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning) - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Good coaching and clean college.

content.Placements: Around 80%-90% of students from our course were placed through campus recruitment drives. Highest package is 20 LPA. Lowest package is 5 LPA. Around 70%-75% of students secure an internship through campus drives. Top roles offered are software development engineer.
content.Infrastructure: Hostel has clean and well-maintained rooms, a common study hall, and a 24/7 water and electricity supply. Mess provides balanced diet food with vegetarian and non-vegetarian options. Facilities for both indoor and outdoor sports. Medical, 24/7 ambulance service.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering (Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning) - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Excellent infrastructure with supportive faculty and good placements.

content.Placements: I am part of the 2024 to 2028 batch. My seniors who passed away from this college received many packages mentioned below. Placement Percentage around 80 to 90% of students are placed from our course. The highest package is 20 LPA, the lowest package is 6 LPA, and the average package is 8 LPA. Some of the top recruiters included TCS, Infosys, Wipro, Cognizant, Accenture, HCL, and a few product based companies. Internship Opportunities Nearly 70 to 80% of students got internships, often in companies like TCS, Infosys, Startups, and local IT firms, which provided good exposure. The major roles offered are Software Developer, Analyst, Associate Engineer, System Engineer, Data Analyst, and Support Engineer.

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. in Computer Science (Artificial Intelligence and Data Analytics) - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Information about Sri Ramachandra life.

content.Placements: Our college offers 100% placements to eligible students. The average package offered is between 4 LPA and 10 LPA. The college has a dedicated placement team. The college organizes on-campus events to help students find jobs and internships. The college has a strong placement network.
content.Infrastructure: Our college has one of the largest medical libraries in the region, and collaborates with Harvard Medical International. It has a large collection of textbooks, journals, and more. We also have modern laboratories. It also exercises physiology labs with metabolic analyzers, treadmills, and more. There is a sports biomechanics lab with 3D cameras, forceplates, and more. We have a podiatry lab with foot pressure analysis systems. There is an anthropometry lab with stadiometers and more.

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. (Hons.) in Medical Microbiology and Applied Molecular Biology - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Sriher a glimpse. Absolutely good infrastructure and social life. The faculty is very friendly.

content.Placements: Our course doesn't have placement arrangements. So I have no idea about it. I don't know what I should say about this topic. But our college does provide a 6-month internship programme within the campus to have hands-on experience with everything we have learnt in these years.
content.Infrastructure: Facilities and infrastructure available are top-notch. There are no compensations for infrastructure. All classrooms are equipped with Wi-Fi connections, smart boards, projectors, etc. The library has a vast number of books about various fields of study and journals. The canteen facilities and medical facilities are good because they have their hospital set up as this is a medical college.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery (MBBS) - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Good infrastructure and faculty members.

content.Placements: There are 250 students in one batch. For MBBS internships are only required in the final year after completion of the course. According to central lawns internships are in the same hospital as the study. After MBBS and internship, there are multiple opportunities to go abroad for further training, as well as opportunities to remain in India and pursue an MS or an MD. As for research, the faculty members are incredibly helpful and the university offers grants for students who wish to engage in research. The medical college is also recognised by the USA for further studies there.

admission_overview.title: Sri Ramachandra University Admission Overview 2025
admission_overview.description: Sri Ramachandra University admission 2025 is entrance-based for some of the courses and merit-based for others. The university considers scores of NEET-UG, NEET MDS, etc. for admission to specififc programmes. SRIHER also conducts its own entrance test to shortlist aspirants for UG and PG courses. The deemed-to-be university offers over 50 courses at UG, PG, and PhD levels through nine faculties. The courses are offered in various streams, including Dental Science, Biomedical Science, Allied Health Sciences, Pharmacy, Physiotherapy, Management, etc. Additionally, SRIHER also provides scholarships to meritorious students.

eligibility_selection.title: Sri Ramachandra University Eligibility & Selection 2025
eligibility_selection.description: Admission at SRIHER is entrance-based. It is also important that the students meet the eligibility criteria. reviews.review_text: The employability rate was successfully higher throughout the end of the year. Top reputed clinics and some other corporates took part in the placement process of our institution. Some students become entrepreneurs and they start their own ventures.

reviews.review_heading: Dental course in Chennai.
reviews.review_text: The required dental equipment and other apparatus are bought once a year. Necessary radiology setups are settled in laboratories. Fire safety equipment, surveillance security, cameras, and necessary medical facilities are arranged in our college.

There is a swimming pool and a gymnasium. There are multiple canteens where students can select food to buy. The mess serves South Indian cuisine. The college has a hospital as well.

reviews.review_heading: Safety for women, refreshment, cultural events, visits to the hospital.

So, there is a visit of celebrities during this. Our college is offering a swimming club, sports club, tennis club, basketball club, cricket club, dance club, and singing club. Our college is having a wide variety of books that help in our study purpose with a central AC in the library.

Academic Facilities include well-equipped classrooms and psychology labs and access to a central library with online resources and journals. Sports & Recreation facilities are present in form of dedicated sp...

reviews.review_text:
Our college will have many festivals like culturals, sports culturals, departmental culturals, etc. Our classrooms will have an air conditioners.
Our department has a library that contains every book we need and has a general Oxford library. Every week there will be an event happening; anyone can take part in any event.

Hostel rooms were furnished and food in the mess was good to eat.

review_content.Placements: We had got a great exposure through college and had worked with all the top companies in PR and Media Industry. individual_reviews.title: Somewhat dissatisfied by the infrastructure but good opportunity for events.

content.Placements: The college offers good training opportunities and internships in top event companies. But the placements are low as compared to the Masters degree. The average placement is only 3-4 Lacs. But at the same time placements also depends a but on the training that has been done throughout the 2 year course period.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of colleges in Mumbai is not so great. There is no big campus. Its only a building where the facilities are provided but you cannot expect a very advanced infrastructure. The canteen in the college is just one with very limited variety.

individual_reviews.course: Post Graduate Diploma in Aspects of Media, Marketing and Events - Batch of 2019
individual_reviews.title: NAEMD- Experience in PGDAME '19.

content.Placements: The placement council is very good. Approximately 85% of the students of the batch were placed. The top roles offered were client servicing, production, operations. 100% of the students got internship opportunities which could also turn into placement offer depending upon the performance of the students. The internship was approximately 2-3 month long so you can do 2 internships in a year that will help in the placement interview.
content.Infrastructure: Hostel is not available, although the college has a broker who can help you get a home with your own batchmates that will be better to know your batchmates better. The classrooms are well ventilated, has AC and table benches for sitting. The size is big enough to accommodate 160 students at a time.

individual_reviews.course: Post Graduate Diploma in Aspects of Media, Marketing and Events - Batch of 2017
individual_reviews.title: This is the best college to get industry exposure.

content.Placements: We had got a great exposure through college and had worked with all the top companies in PR and Media Industry. There are 100% guaranteed placements, but it all depends on how you perform throughout your academic year. The faculty members of our college are very much supportive in terms of getting internships, and they give the right guidance to the students.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of our college is spacious enough for 800 to 1,000 students to accommodate at a time. Our college provides facilities like in-house canteen, Wi-Fi, air-conditioned classrooms with projectors, and 24*7 security surveillance. The food served in the canteen is hygiene with a cheap rates.

individual_reviews.course: BMS in Event Management and PR - Batch of 2017
individual_reviews.title: National Academy of Event Management and Development is good for event management.

content.Placements: The college provides placements opportunities to the students. The highest salary offered was 4.8 LPA and the lowest package offered was 2 LPA. Around 70% to 80% of the students got placed through college placements. There was no placement cell in the college. Companies like ABEC, Red Cherry and Scarlet came for the placements during my time.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of our college was good. The classes were fully equipped with projectors and AC. We have WiFi enabled throughout the campus. The college has its library. Our college does not have a big campus; there are no medical facilities, and also, there was no playground on the campus. Our college doesn't have a hostel facility for boys.

individual_reviews.course: BMS in Event Management and PR - Batch of 2020
individual_reviews.title: There are really good faculty and placements.

content.Placements: I'm currently working as a freelancer, but I've good contacts in event industry because of NAMED. College also helps to get your internship or job if you want. The campus interview also happens in the college after completing your course. You must join this college if you want to make your career in event-field.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of the college is good. They have air-conditioner facility in the classrooms, and the campus is quite big. They have a library too. You can use books if you want or computer is also there. The only problem is classes are on the 5th floor, and they don't have the lift, so it is quite difficult.

overview_faqs.question: Is BSc Agriculture available at RPCAU?
overview_faqs.answer: Yes, BSc (Hons) in Agriculture is available at Agriculture Dr. Rajendra Prasad Central Agricultural University. The programme is offered in one of the affiliated college of RPCAU i.e., Tirhut College of Agriculture. The programme lasts for four years and is offered across eight semesters. individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Agricultural Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Review of Dr. Rajendra Prasad Central Agricultural University.

content.Placements: I am currently pursuing a B.Tech in Agricultural Engineering. It contains around 37 students, but the capacity is 44. Talking about placements, students often go for higher studies through GATE or CAT, but, there are placements. Companies like TAFE, Mahindra, Dehat, etc., come to our campus, offering an average package of around 3.5-4 LPA. The highest package is around 12 LPA.

admission_process.title: SSSIHL Admission Process 2025

paragraphs: SSSIHL admission process 2025is based on themerit listfor all UG courses. The application process is completely online at the institute.

Sri Sathya Sai Institute of Higher Learning (SSSIHL), Anantapur offers a wide range ofUG programmesincludingBSc, BA, BCometc., and also offers a few PG programmes, such as MBA and MTech. For theMBA,SSSIHLaccepts admission on the basis ofCAT/CMAT/ XATfollowed by GD & PI. Candidates must have a minimum60% aggregatein Class 12 for UG course admission. The shortlisted candidates will be asked to attend anonline interviewby SSSIHL.

Established bySri Satya Sai Baba, SSSIHL is a modern Gurukala which inculcates ethical and moral values in students. Currently, admissions are open forPhDprogrammes. The admission acceptance rate at the institute is23%. Candidates seeking admission for the 2025 academic year, are advised to go through the admission prospectus. Check out the SSSIHL admission 2025 details below:

At the undergraduate level, there are several courses available inHumanities, Social Sciences,Management & Commerce and Sciences. The requirements for admissions vary from programme to programme at SSSIHL. There isno entrance testforundergraduateprogrammes admission. Applications will be shortlisted based onmerit. Below are the SSSIHL eligibility and selection criteria details for some of theSSSIHL courses:

Sri Sathya Sai Institute provides education without any fee (except for a few programmes) to students. The fee waiver includes tuition, exams, lab, library, sports, medical assistance etc. Professional programmes, such as MBA and MTech, are chargeable. Further, the seat intake for ME/MTech is 36, and BBM/BMS is 80.

Coming to affordability, It is among the causes of many students quitting college or their degree. Although the availability of student loans and scholarships has made education more affordable, qualifying for one of these loans or scholarships frequently comes with a set of requirements that must be met. Find below theSSSIHL tuition fee, seats along with average package details for the MBA course:

Eligible candidates seeking admission to SSIHL courses can applyonlineby filling out an application form. Once candidates have successfully completed their application form, wait to hear from the institute in regards application. The selection process varies from programme to programme at SSIHL. Find below the step-by-step SSIHL admission process 2025:
Step 1: Application: Apply online on the official website of SSSIHL @sssihl.edu.in

Step 2: Selection round:Candidates will be selected on the basis ofmeritfor allUG courses admission.The shortlisted candidates will be asked to attend anonline interview. There is no admissions test for UG programmes at SSSIHL. The selected individuals (on the list) will also receive an email confirming this.

For the MBA, eligible applicants will be asked to take anonline admissions test. Shortlisted candidates will then be invited for anofflineGroup Discussionand aninterview. Applicants with valid scores inCAT/CMAT/ XATare exempted from the admissions test and will be invited directly for the offline Group Discussion round, followed by an interview.

For MTech, Eligible applicants will be asked to take an online admissions test. Shortlisted candidates will then be invited for an offlineTechnical Viva Voce, followed by an interview. applicants with a validGATE/ CSIR/ JESTscore in relevant fields are exempted from the admissions test and will be invited directly for the Technical Viva Voce round, followed by an interview.

Step 3: Document Verification:At the time of joining SSIHL, candidates need to submit a few documents that are Original Marks Certificate, Transfer Certificate, Conduct Certificate and Health record etc.

reviews.review_text: Classrooms are very good. Labs are excellent according to my thinking. In B. Pharmacy, labs play an important role than theory class. For PG students regular class is available with advanced experiential labs. A hoste...

reviews.review_heading: All faculty members in our college are awesome.
reviews.review_text: Labs are best. It has all the chemical and practical related books and materials. The library is very useful for all students as they provide all the books that are important for our practical and subjects which we studied in our course. There is no hostel in our college. The canteen is the best in our college. We get good and affordable food. There are many sports and games in our college. There are international-level and college-level games also like football and basketball.

reviews.review_heading: College itself is average and infrastructure is very good.
reviews.review_text: I must say, infrastructure is very good. There are lots of classrooms, libraries, canteens, difference types of labs, Wi-Fi in every corners of the campus and many more. When it comes to hostel, I would say it's okay, it's not that good but it's not bad either. The food quality is great and I love the taste.

reviews.review_heading: Review of VNS Group of Technology Bhopal.
reviews.review_text: The lab and the classrooms are well-furnished and equipped with AC. The infrastructure is good with beautiful gardens. There are guards on the campus to provide security.

reviews.review_heading: The college is very good. There is a lot to study and learn.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college is very good. The list of courses is very good. Students will get to learn good courses in this college. I have not stayed in the hostel but my friend stays in the hostel. The infrastructure of the college is in a very good location and it is also convenient for the students to come and go. There are many other co-curricular activities in the college.

reviews.review_heading: Mining Diploma from VNS College.
reviews.review_text: Hostel facilities and infrastructure are very good, and hostel rooms are clean. Every room has a study table and some other stuff. Every room has 2 students sharing. Mess food quality is quite decent. The hostel has Wi-Fi, and the library also has Wi-Fi. Hostel fees are 65,000 per year.

reviews.review_heading: Review of VNS Group of Institutions.
reviews.review_text:
AC labs, AC-provided rooms, well-furnished classes, good infrastructure, highly qualified teachers, well-developed buildings, etc. are there.
Natural and beautiful gardening area. Good guards are there. Maintained rules and regulations for students. Labs have full AC coverage and a good view to see our future brightly.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely amazing because they provide quality education and train students.
reviews.review_text: Our college provides lots of facilities in the Department of Pharmacy. Facilities such as access to the computer lab and daily lab facilities for subjects like Pharmacology and Pharmaceutics are provided. Our college has a license for handling animals. There is a library and Wi-Fi infrastructure. The infrastructure is also good. However, our college does not provide hostel facilities.

reviews.review_heading: The worst college. If you really wants to save your future try other colleges.
reviews.review_text: For a student who does not afford much can take admission in this college because they only want a degree. I don't know about the hostel because I do not live in hostel here.

reviews.review_heading: Our college is very good. I am satisfied with this college because of its good faculty members.
reviews.review_text: The hostel facility is good. Our college provides free Wi-Fi. It has good labs, large classrooms, and a library. The quality of facilities in our hostel is good. The food served in the mess and canteen is very good.

reviews.review_heading: VNS Group of Institutions has value for money.
reviews.review_text: On campus, there is no hostel available. There is a huge library where approximately 50 to 60 students can sit and study at one time. All types of books are available in the library. Wi-Fi is available throughout the campus. Our classrooms and labs are quite good. All types of equipment are available in labs.

reviews.review_heading: Our college is one of the best colleges for pharmacy in Bhopal.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our college and classrooms is average. Laboratories are good for performing experiments and practicals. All the equipment is available in good condition. The auditorium and seminar halls are average. Various informative sessions are held in seminar halls. There are no hostels available.

reviews.review_heading: It is an average college in certain fields.
reviews.review_text: Facilities are good on daily basis. Laboratories are well maintained with proper facilities. Equipment is also good in this college. Classrooms are well furnished. The canteen facilities are not good, and the food quality is average. Sports and games are held regularly.

reviews.review_heading: I had a good college experience in this college.
reviews.review_text: The facilities provided are pretty good in the CSE department. VNS has at least 150 computers. The hostel is quite far from college, but it is not a downside as they provide comfortable bus facilities from college to your place. The college is pretty equipped with essential necessities for students.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely it is the worst college.
reviews.review_text: Our college has the worst infrastructure I have ever seen. It has a poor library and a pathetic and unhygienic canteen facility. Labs are available just for namesake, and they don't have proper equipment and materials. Everything is outdated in labs.

admission_process.title: Karpagam Academy of Higher Education Admission process 2025

paragraphs: Karpagam Academy of Higher Education admissionto all courses, except for BTech and BArch, is merit-based. TheKAHE BTech admission criteria are entrance-based;the institute accepts national-level entrance exam scores, such as JEE Main and NATA scores, to shortlist candidates for admission. For other courses, admission is given based on the fulfilment of eligibility criteria and performance in the qualifying exam. The application process for the university commences online. Interested candidates have to visit the official website and download the application form from the relevant section. Further, candidates need to send the admission form along with the required documents to the official email ID given on the website. Interested students can read the following article to learn all about the courses, eligibility criteria, and admission process forKAHE.

Karpagam Academy of Higher Education offers more than 15 courses viafour facultiesat theUG and PG levels.The courses are offered in different areas of study such asManagement, Law,Artsand Humanities,Engineering, etc. The University also offers acertificate course in Data Science.

As per the KAHE official website, admission to the BTech and BArch programmes is done based on the performance of the candidates in JEE Main and NATA, respectively. Admission to other KAHE courses is merit-based. However, candidates need to meet the eligibility criteria of their desired course to be considered for admission at KAHE. Interested candidates can check out the table below for the general eligibility and selection criteria for popularKAHE courses:

Karpagam Academy of Higher Education feesvary course-wise. The KAHE fee ranges between INR 1.2 L and INR 15 L. Candidates need to pay the course fee at the time of admission to confirm their seat at the institute. Below is theKAHE feeand average package for all courses:
Note: The fees mentioned above is taken from official sources and is subject to change.

The KAHE seat intake for each course is different and depends on various factors such as the number of applications received for that course, the number of specialisations offered, etc. The table below shows the course-wise total seat intake of KAHE courses:

KAHE evaluates the performance of the candidate in the qualifying exam to shortlist candidates for admission to all courses, except for BTech and BArch. Candidates seeking admission to BTech and BArch courses are required to appear for the course-specific entrance exams.

Eligible candidates can begin theirKAHE course admission processby applying to the desired course through the official website. The Karpagam Academy of Higher Education application process is mentioned below:
Step 1: KAHE Application Process

KAHE application processis conducted inonline mode. Candidates can visit the official website of the institute and download the application form. After filling the form, they need to mail the duly filled form, along with the demand draft, on registrar@kahedu.edu.in.
Step 2: Selection Process

KAHE offers direct admission to candidateson the basis of the merit obtained in the qualifying exam. However, forBTech and BArch admission,candidates must have a valid score in JEE Main and NATA, respectively.
Step 3: Result Declaration and Admission Confirmation

After the selection rounds are completed, KAHE releases a merit list on its official website with the names of selected applicants. The candidates are required to appear for the document verification round and pay the admission fee to secure their admission.

faqs.question: What is the admission process of Karpagam Academy of Higher Education?
faqs.answer: Admission to Karpagam Academy of Higher Education courses isbased on either merit or the results of several entrance tests. Karpagam Academy of Higher Education in Coimbatore is a deemed university that was established in 2008. It is NAAC-accredited and authorized by UGC-AICTE, MHRD, PCI, and COA. Among the UG, PG, and doctorate programs provided by the institution are management, computer applications, commerce, science, humanities, engineering, architecture, astrology, and social work. It offers excellent work opportunities in large corporations as well as great campus amenities.

faqs.question: Can I get direct admission at Karpagam Academy of Higher Education?
faqs.answer: No, Karpagam Academy of Higher Education generally does not offer direct admissions to students. Candidates looking to join the college are required to satisfy the minimum educational qualification specified by the college for the desired course. For most of the courses, students are required to appear for the accepted entrance exam. Students can visit the official website of college for more information.

faqs.question: What is the eligibility criteria for B.Tech at Karpagam Academy of Higher Education?
faqs.answer: Karpagam Academy of Higher Education (KAHE) is a university in Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu, India. It established under Section 3 of the UGC Act 1956, which was approved by the Ministry of Human Resource and Development of the Government of India.For B.Tech - Candidates seeking admission to the B.Tech course at Karpagam Academy of Higher Education in Coimbatore must have completed their 10 + 2 years of schooling with a minimum of 50% aggregate from a recognised institute. This course requires the JEE Main entrance exam. B.Tech is a four-year program.

placement_data.title: Karpagam Academy of Higher Education Placement Overview 2024
paragraphs: As per Karpagam Academy of Higher Education NIRF report 2024, the median package offered during UG 3-year , UG 4-year and UG 5-year placements 2023 stood at INR 2.46 LPA , INR 1.92 LPA and I NR 3.12 LPA , respectively. Apart from this, the median package offered during PG 2-year placements 2023 stood at INR 2.52 LPA .

Earlier, as per the official website, a total of 300 students were placed in over 20 companies during Karpagam University placements 2022. In the year 2022, more than 93% placement rate recorded during Karpagam University placements. The top recruiters of KAHE in the past few years were Infosys, Wipro, TCS, Cognizant, IBM, etc.

faqs.question: What was the highest package offered at Karpagam Academy of Higher Education?
faqs.answer: The highest package goes up to 14 to 15 Lacs per annum. The median package offered is around INR 2.2 LPA. According to the official website of Karpagam Academy of Higher Education, a total of 300 students were placed in over 20 companies during Karpagam University placements 2022 and more than 93% placement rate recorded during Karpagam University placements. The top recruiters of KAHE were Infosys, Wipro, TCS, Cognizant, IBM, etc.

faqs.question: How are B.Sc placements at Karpagam Academy of Higher Education?
faqs.answer: The B.Sc placements in Karpagam academy of higher education can be considered average. In 2021 out of all the students enrolled in B.Sc program 62% were placed in various companies. In 2022 out of all the students enrolled about 59 percent were placed. The average package offered for this course was about 2 lakhs in 2021 and 2.3 lakhs in 2022 (approximately 19k per month) So, though the average package increased from 2021 to 2022, there is a drop in the number of students getting placed.

faqs.question: Which has better placement at Karpagam Academy of Higher Education, B.Sc or M.Sc?
faqs.answer: The students with M.Sc tend to get more job oppurtunities than B.Sc. Students in courses other than courses like CS and IT should definitely take up M.Sc to get good packages as majority of students with just B.Sc course end up having less or nil packages. That's why it is preferred to complete post graduation. There are some major companies and they prefer M.Sc students over B.Sc students during placements .These include 1.ACCENTURE 2.BYJU'S 3.COGNIZANT 4.IDFC 5.INFOSYS 6.MOONPRODUCT 7.MR COPPER Doing M.Sc increases the chances of getting a placement.

faqs.question: What is the hostel fee at Karpagam Academy of Higher Education?
faqs.answer: Hostel Fees for both Girls and Boys is Rs. 63000 per year Room Type: Non AC Curfew Time: 11:00 PM Other Facilities: Water Cooler, Electricity Backup, Wi-Fi Internet Services, Security Karpagam University hostel buildings are different for boys and girls scholars. It provides them with all modern facilities and provisions for recreational activities. Medical, engineering, and paramedical colleges have different hostel buildings. The scholars must live in the students' hostel. However, they can make their residential arrangements but a consent letter is to be provided by the parents. Karpagam University hostel facilities are: Provision of common rooms for recreational activities. Students have an access to TV rooms during their free time. Karpagam University hostel rooms are well-maintained and beautifully furnished. Separate blocks are made for boys and girls and spacious rooms are provided to the scholars. Karpagam University hostel rules are as follows: Ragging is prohibited in the hostel and no leniency is given to the scholar who is found guilty. Students can occupy only that room which is allotted to them. Changing the room is not allowed. The chief warden has the right to check the rooms of hostellers in case of any doubt of wrongdoing or unlawful activities. Karpagam University hostel food is delicious. The mess is responsible for serving clean and hygienic to the hostellers.

reviews.review_heading: A satisfactory college experience for engineering students.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructural support for my course is good. It has properly equipped classrooms and labs. Along with conducive learning atmosphere. Hostel facilities are also adequate with basic facilities and a comfortable living atmosphere. In essence, infrastructural support is very good for academics and living.

reviews.review_heading: It is a decent college in Bangalore with good connectivity and a campus.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms are like normal classrooms and nothing very fancy, but not bad either. Every classroom is equipped with a projector. Labs and the library have fast Wi-Fi. The library has over 40,000 books. Washrooms are decent but could be improved.

reviews.review_heading: A decent college and strict dress code.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms, labs, and the library are good. Minor improvements needed in the canteen and Wi-Fi connection. Medical support is available. Sports facilities are decent. Hostel and mess details are unknown. Separate lifts and washrooms are provided for staff and students.

reviews.review_heading: Decent college with good placements, infrastructure, and teaching faculty members.
reviews.review_text: College has good infrastructure with Wi-Fi availability in labs and library. Classrooms are projections and washrooms are cleaned regularly. The library is very big with good seating arrangements. Hostel rooms are average, and food quality is good. There is a playground and gym.

reviews.review_heading: Comprehensive academic and career development at MVJCE.
reviews.review_text: MVJCE offers modern, well-equipped facilities that support quality engineering and management education. Engineering & technology facilities like smart classrooms equipped with projectors, audio-visual aids, and Wi-Fi. There are well-equipped labs, department-specific labs (CSE, ECE, mech, civil, etc.) AI/ML lab, IoT Lab, VLSI lab, data science lab, robotics lab, and programming labs with the latest systems and licensed software. The central library is equipped with more than 60,000 books, journ...

reviews.review_heading: No sports facility but very good infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is new and updated, and facilities are also very good. Wi-Fi is present in all plots of the college but not accessible. Labs are also highly equipped with updated equipment. The quality of the facilities in the hostel is very poor, and the quality of food available in mess is also not good. Zero sports and game facilities.

reviews.review_heading: College has an good infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is good, and there are decent classrooms, labs, and hostel. I am not sure about the hostel thing because I am a day scholar. There are extra-curricular activities like sports, games, events and volunteers. We have many college clubs like dance, literally, singing, etc.

reviews.review_heading: I suggest students do not join this college if they want to become engineers.
reviews.review_text: It has the average infrastructure of labs and classrooms with no Wi-Fi. The hostel is too bad with no proper rooms and bad food. The canteen is a big setback with the worst food and no encouragement for sports and games. It has average medical facilities.

reviews.review_heading: MVJCE is the best engineering college.
reviews.review_text: MVJ College of Engineering offers comprehensive facilities to support both academic and extracurricular activities. There are modern classrooms, advanced labs, Wi-Fi, and more than 50,000 books in a 17,000 sq. Ft. library. There is a separate hostel for boys and girls. We have shared rooms, a cafeteria, gym, ATM, laundry, and medical care. Nutritious meals are there in the mess and canteen. Indoor and outdoor courts include tennis, badminton, and basketball. There is a gym with trainers. On-camp...

reviews.review_heading: College is good. I would recommend this college to others.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi labs are good, with good infrastructure and spacious classrooms with projectors. The food in the canteen is average. College has gym, medical center, playground, and basketball ground. Auditorium and parking lots are spacious with very good security.

reviews.review_heading: MVJ College of Engineering Bangalore
reviews.review_text: MVJ College of Engineering provides good facilities like modern classrooms, well-equipped labs, a library with many books and e-resources, and campus-wide Wi-Fi. Hostels are clean and offer basic amenities. The mess serves decent food, and the canteen has snacks and beverages. Medical care is available on campus, and there are facilities for sports like cricket, football, and indoor games. The overall infrastructure supports learning and student activities.

reviews.review_heading: MVJCE has good placements and well qualified teachers.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure are very good. We enjoy a lot on campus. Facilities are very good they help all students to get job opportunities. Hostel rooms are good. The mess food is very good and delicious. But only vegetarian food is available in mess.

reviews.review_heading: Decent & Bit Flawed College.
reviews.review_text: The facilities offered in MVJCE are good. They have Wi-Fi accessibility, good laboratories, and spacious classrooms (although a few classes look dark and suffocating). It has a good library with various collections of books from numerous authors. I'm a day scholar, so I don't know how the hostel operates. But I heard that it's average. Rooms are pretty decent, but the food is strictly average, and only vegetarian food is available! It has enough sports amenities and many sports events, but baske...

reviews.review_heading: Review of M.V.J. College of Engineering
reviews.review_text: Our college recently introduced state-of-the-art lab facilities. There are special labs like NI LabView, Microsoft, VLSI, Robolab, and advanced communication. These are the highlights. There are 2 boys' hostels and one girls' hostel. They are decent.

reviews.review_heading: Amazing college with great infrastructure
reviews.review_text: MVJ College of Engineering has a pretty good infrastructure. They have spacious classrooms, well-equipped labs, and a good library. The campus is big and has facilities for sports and other activities. There's a canteen and a medical center too. Overall, it's a decent place to study.

For a few courses, the university also accepts other national-level entrance exams, such as NTA, and TANCET.

reviews.review_heading: I am satisfied with this college.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is available every time. There are no specific labs. Classrooms are fully furnished and very professional, with projectors in every room. It is a fully digital college. There is a hostel facility, but the hostel is not considered good as per reviews. Students prefer private PGs as they have to shift PGs according to their internships. Sports and games activities are conducted occasionally on a regular basis. Almost every weekend is dedicated to sports by seniors.

reviews.review_heading: It is the business college that teaches you what is happening in the real world.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is top-notch with 1 GBPS speed and no lag. The classrooms are spacious with proper lights and everything. There is no Library of GCEC, but VGU has a library, and we can use that. The quality of food is good. Games facilities are good.

reviews.review_heading: This college provides good infrastructure and facilities.
reviews.review_text: Everything is modern and up to date. Free Wi-Fi is enabled, and an air-conditioner in all the classrooms are provided. Hostel facilities are also available and many clubs are also arranged for extracurricular. Good quality food and playground are open for all kinds of sports. There is a small library in the canteen.

reviews.review_heading: Our college is good for students who want to do entrepreneurship.
reviews.review_text: All the facilities are available on the campus. Our college provides facilities like a cafeteria. The library is the best places as most of the logical discussions and debates are conducted there only. All types of equipment related to sports are available on the campus. Hostels are clean, and the food served in the mess is average.

reviews.review_heading: GCEC is the best college in India.
reviews.review_text: We have well-furnished classrooms with digitalised education and good Wi-Fi which gives us good speed. No there is no sports facility but every year a sports day is conducted in our college in which we play our favorite games. The canteen on the campus is well-furnished.

reviews.review_heading: The college emits an aura of learning and freedom.
reviews.review_text: The college has positive, energetic and motivating vibes. Classrooms are equipped with projectors, AC's, Wi-Fi. There are sports grounds for all common sports played. GCEC has its own canteen that serves great food. Hostel facilities are also provided by the college.

reviews.review_heading: I am satisfied with the course, faculty members and infrastructure of our college.
reviews.review_text: All the classrooms here are very good and have a Wi-Fi facility, charging sockets at every seat, air-conditioners and projector. The library is always updated. The hostel facility is also available with air-conditioned and non-air-conditioned rooms and very good food quality. Cleanliness is maintained for proper hygiene, and they care about the health of the students. Almost all the sports and games are played at the university like football, basketball, cricket and rugby.

reviews.review_heading: It is the best college for entrepreneurship in India.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college is well maintained, and all the classrooms have air-conditioners and Wi-Fi. It has a positive, energetic and motivating vibe. GCEC has its canteen that serves good food. I am staying in the university hostel, which is good, and the food served in the mess is also good. There is a sports ground for all of the common sports played.

reviews.review_heading: More Practical than Theoretical.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure in college is excellent. The classrooms are very good and there is Wi-Fi in the college. Coming to the hostel, the hostel is not maintained by the GCEC. So, however, the hostel is it is not the responsibility of this college. The hostel is maintained by VGU. It is not bad.

reviews.review_heading: Join GCEC if you think you're capable of sitting amongst the smartest pool of students.
reviews.review_text: The campus is for the people, of the people, and by the people. The campus is really futuristic, and the classrooms are well-lit by the lights as well as sunlight and are fully air-conditioned. There are smart classrooms with projector facilities, and the campus is hygienic. Changes can be made in the infrastructure by polling as the majority to a specific change. There is a world class incubation centre, and there are a basketball court, volleyball court, cricket and football ground, badminton ...

reviews.review_heading: Perfect college, I feel privileged to be part of this college.
reviews.review_text:
Classroom -AC classroom
Auditorium - events too place 
Huge campus 
Sports ground- badminton, basketball, cricket can be played there
Computer labs- computers available 
Hostel facilities available for all students who wish to take this facility 
Wi-Fi available 
Medical facilities available 
Library is there where students can sit and read books, issue books of their choice.

reviews.review_heading: A very unique college with realistic education.
reviews.review_text: The college will be shifted to VGU, and their infrastructure is brilliant. Classrooms are enabled with air-conditioners and projector are used for teaching. The canteen food is good with reasonable rate. Overall campus infrastructure is up to the mark and still developing.

reviews.review_heading: Give good exposure to your life and career.
reviews.review_text: Facilities at college are very good it have Wi-Fi AC classrooms, small batch size so teacher can focus on every student, library, extra activities related to case study solving questions, fun activities, product launching, marking activities and many more.

reviews.review_heading: Jaipur's best place to be.
reviews.review_text: It's worth the money. The infrastructure is not too good but we have AC classrooms. We've variety of competitions to participate in. I'd not suggest the hostelers, since there are other students from the University there. Rather one can go for PG or something.

reviews.review_heading: The new way of education focused mainly upon practical grooming than of theoretical learning.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is not good, but it doesn't matter as we live as a family in Global Centre for Entrepreneurship and Commerce (GCEC). This is the issue which GCEC is trying to resolve this problem.
